definitions.explanation: The final part or outcome of a story, event, or situation. Often implies a resolution or settlement. Composed of 結 (tie, conclude) + 末 (end).

examples.japanese: {結末|けつまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結末|けつまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the ending of this novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}いがけない{結末|けつまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: The case reached an unexpected conclusion, surprising everyone involved.

notes:
USAGE:
{結末|けつまつ} refers to the conclusion or final outcome of events, stories, or situations. It is commonly used when discussing narratives (novels, movies, dramas) as well as real-life events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結末|けつまつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach a conclusion)
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧な{結末|けつまつ} (unexpected ending)
- ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧{結末|けつまつ} (sad ending)
- ハッピーエンド⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{結末|けつまつ} (happy ending)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ means result or outcome and is more general. {結末|けつまつ} specifically implies the final resolution of a sequence of events. ⟦{終結|しゅうけつ}→終結：13851_shuuketsu⟧ means conclusion or termination and is more formal.
